scope: Second bounded general-source research round on 23 October. Experimental probes and a metadata-only static-index prototype; no production module, source registry, build, deployment, account, extension or runtime backend changed.

previousRound.interpretation: The earlier browser-readable Archive corpus still has six canonical recordings, one already-known Egiozu excerpt match and zero new matches. This round adds a different static-generation/opaque-media transport method and a new provider. Earlier negatives and scoped counts are retained.

methods.rejectedCandidate: Queen / Bohemian Rhapsody: low correlation and incompatible duration; not indexed or played.
methods.discovery: The same algorithm consumes generic title/album/artist Archive search candidates; no provider item ID or media URL is hardcoded into the probe.
methods.generation: A local/build-time HTTPS job rehydrates canonical catalog identity, reads public provider metadata and the bounded full candidate, verifies length/MD5/SHA1, computes SHA256 and compares the official excerpt and a distinct negative. Only metadata and proof enter a static JSON index; media stays in RAM.
methods.runtime: From the actual Pages origin, read public Archive file metadata via CORS, match file name/length/MD5/SHA1 to the index, and set ordinary HTMLAudio with no crossorigin attribute to the canonical provider download URL. JavaScript still cannot inspect the opaque media bytes. No proxy or browser-security override.
methods.observation: One trusted Play click, separate seek, unmuted desktop Chrome 153 tab hidden for 30 seconds; observation RPCs declare userGesture:false.
methods.trustLimit: Runtime checks provider metadata, not actual opaque audio bytes. Metadata/media binding and a time-of-check/time-of-use gap remain; weaker than byte-verified Blob playback.
methods.coverageLimit: Finite generated index; new/changed provider files require regeneration. Missing/changed proof must reject the candidate and continue to another source.

methods.discovery: Generic title/artist/album queries select playable music records with public local uploads; private or metadata-only records are excluded. No song IDs or media addresses are hardcoded in the probe.
methods.verification: Selected/hydrated canonical IDs, artist, album, title_version and duration remain consistent. Fetch the whole candidate via normal CORS with omitted credentials and a compressed-byte bound, compute candidate/reference/negative SHA256, and compare the official excerpt. Play the same candidate bytes as a RAM-only Blob.
methods.observation: Three recordings by three artists; two checks each, six checks total, not six distinct songs. Trusted click, seek and 10-second hidden desktop playback pass in final frozen runs.
methods.identityLimit: The three source records/files supply no usable ISRC or recording MBID. Acoustic verification cannot be replaced by text metadata. A product adapter must also explicitly reject any declared conflicting ISRC/version/recording MBID; the current positive probes only encounter missing identifiers.
methods.deliveryLimit: Development v2 API on this pod; version/anonymous-setting detection is needed. The NIN OGG file redirects to a signed storage URL with a declared 3600-second lifetime. Keep stable provider upload identifiers and re-resolve; do not persist temporary signed URLs. OGG support on physical iPhone is not established.
methods.withheldCase: Kai Engel / Collateral fails one separated window despite a high aggregate correlation. Thresholds were not relaxed. Rejection is not proof of a different master.

catalog.title: The Less I Know The Better

additionalBoundedInvestigations.method: Additional YouTube MWEB / embedded TV clients and Onesie bootstrap
additionalBoundedInvestigations.result: No new usable direct audio. MWEB and TV variants fail including playable controls; bootstrap is unreadable via normal CORS. Parser libraries requiring proxy/extension do not satisfy pure-PWA constraints. No protected keys, requests or signed media are retained.

Public title search discovers Izaro / Olentzero and a track marker. Pages search fails CORS/JSONP; one normal click in the provider UI supplies no audio request. Metadata lead only, no full-audio or identity/background success.

Node-only public HTTP responses include encoded results rather than a readable song array, including a control. No empty-catalog, audio or browser-transport claim; no decryption, account or regional workaround.

additionalBoundedInvestigations.method: Navidrome and Audiomack public integration documentation
additionalBoundedInvestigations.result: Owner-created public shares are not a global anonymous catalog. Official Audiomack reads still require an application consumer secret. No account or borrowed credential added.

limits: Whole candidate files were obtained/decoded, with compatible durations, but identity comparison covers only the official approximately 30-second excerpt and three separated windows. Unreferenced audio is not independently authenticated; this does not prove an entire master.

Distinct-song negatives and synthetic controls do not calibrate arbitrary covers, near-identical remasters, remixes, live recordings, medleys or edited files. Real version-conflict corpus tests are still required for automatic substitution.
All new hidden-tab observations are desktop browser probes, not the installed app, actual Android/iPhone screen-off, OS backgrounding, natural ended or queue continuity.
Compressed file reads are bounded; decoded PCM, FFT memory and total pipeline deadline are not yet a mobile-safe bounded worker design. Do not move the desktop diagnostic wholesale into the phone.
Anonymous listening or a declared license field does not by itself enable offline downloads or redistribution; this round adds neither.
No source was established for the difficult Epoitaitaye recording (catalog 3279314641, ISRC QM6N21489743). Limited empty queries do not prove global absence.
Four new positives demonstrate useful coverage gain and two reusable methods, not a universal no-account commercial music service.
recommendedIntegration: Prioritize a generic automatically generated static identity index, beginning with public Funkwhale and verified Archive candidates; no per-song product if/else registry.
Bind index entries to canonical track ID, ISRC, title_version, artist, album and duration. Freeze provenance, fail on conflicting source identity, and reject missing or changed verification.

For CORS-readable media, verify the fetched whole file SHA256 and play those same bytes as a Blob in the existing single Audio pipeline. Treat opaque streaming as a separately explicit weaker metadata-trust mode, not as byte verification.
Keep existing manual choices, local audio and podcast priorities. Re-resolve expiring provider locators; bound cancellation, memory, requests and overall deadlines.

Before release, test source cancellation, selected-track continuity, seeks, retry, repeat, natural next-track and app updates. Then physically verify installed Xiaomi and iPhone playback/background/lock for the new provider and codec paths.

syntaxChecks.scope: Five new QA probes and two preserved source snapshots; node --check.

persistedMediaAndTemporaryAddressScan.scope: All new JSON artifacts, new-file media extensions, independent review of nested strings/URLs. No media/base64, credentials or signed playback URL retained.
